Thousands took part in a rally organised by COCOMI in Imphal, demanding the abrogation of the Suspension of Operations (SoO) agreement and the safe return of internally displaced persons. Protesters also sought the Manipur Chief Minister’s resignation, days after an ambush killed three Meitei men.
